problem: The merged BB-006 runtime/capture harness was not yet executed automatically, so P0 lacked retained exact-head desktop/mobile visual evidence and proof that release builds hide the QA bridge.

decision.rationale: Extend the existing unprivileged exact-source HTML5 CI job so the already-built development/release bundles are served by the canonical QA server, captured with pinned Playwright Chromium and retained as a separate visual-qa artifact. Keep the trusted pull_request_target evidence authority unchanged.

research.candidate_pool_exception: Shipped-product research is not applicable to CI/governance wiring.
research.reference_exception: This process change has no player-facing behavior or quality decision.

anti_pattern.observation: Executing candidate runtime/browser tooling from the privileged trusted workflow would expand the pull_request_target trust boundary.
anti_pattern.lesson: Keep Playwright and candidate runtime execution under the existing read-only pull_request/push HTML5 workflow.

official_docs.verified_constraint: Candidate-source test/build execution belongs under pull_request/push while pull_request_target has a distinct privileged security model.
Generated capture/report files can be retained as named workflow artifacts with explicit retention.
Playwright supports installing Chromium and its required operating-system dependencies through the CLI for CI execution.
The pinned Python Playwright package and installed Chromium provide the browser automation runtime used by the merged capture runner.

alternatives.reason: Reuses the exact-source Bob bundles and browser smoke already produced by HTML5 CI, avoiding duplicate builds and keeping one P0 browser artifact contract.
A second workflow would rebuild the same HTML5 source, increase drift risk and split browser evidence across independent source executions.
The privileged trusted-base governance workflow must validate candidate metadata/policy, not execute candidate runtime or browser code.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Every successful HTML5 CI run executes the merged foundation_probe against desktop_reference and mobile_landscape using pinned Playwright Chromium.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Exact candidate run 33214438370 on head 56fa405c48d7c193c5e9888b825c48a0779c93a2 executed Playwright Chromium 151.0.7922.34 and captured foundation_probe at 1280x720 and 844x390.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The visual capture runs against the same exact-source development/release bundles already built by HTML5 CI and uses the canonical local HTTP server.

manual: Downloaded visual artifact 9702826036 was inspected: both retained images show the intended centered foundation_probe marker at their exact configured viewport dimensions and do not claim a gameplay visual state.
verification.runtime_errors: No actionable runtime errors were observed. Both captures report console_error_count=0 and page_error_count=0. Chromium emitted WebGL ReadPixels performance warnings during one screenshot pass; these are warning-level capture-side diagnostics, not page/runtime exceptions, and exact repeated PNG hashes still matched. Release QA bridge/probe absence passed.

governance.trust_boundary_change: The existing unprivileged pull_request/push HTML5 CI job gains installation/execution of candidate Playwright visual-QA tooling and a new retained visual artifact. The privileged pull_request_target trusted evidence workflow, ruleset authority and policy code are unchanged.
governance.bypass_analysis: Candidate branches can edit their own visual capture code/workflow, so the visual artifact is runtime evidence rather than governance authority. Trusted-base validate-pr-evidence continues to classify the candidate diff and require the governance manifest independently. Playwright execution receives only read-only repository contents permission and no secrets/write token.
governance.rollback: Remove the Playwright install/capture/upload additions from .github/workflows/defold-runtime-evidence.yml. The merged runtime harness and existing BB-005 playable HTML5 CI remain usable locally; no production gameplay/save state or trusted ruleset depends on the visual artifact step.

known_limitations: BB-006 captures the infrastructure-only foundation_probe; player-facing state fixtures are added by the milestones that own those systems.
Motion capture and selective visual-regression thresholds remain later BB-P008 scope.
The visual artifact is retained for CI diagnosis/evidence, not permanent release hosting.
